item.title: Minutes 1.0.0 (70)
item.description:
• Recording keeps going when your microphone changes: if AirPods move to another device, Minutes switches to another microphone, or records Mac audio only until one returns
  • If a recording is interrupted, everything captured is still transcribed, and the gaps are listed
  • Continue Recording (in the meeting's ⋯ menu) adds more to an existing meeting
  • Rounded search bar, always in the same place

item.title: Minutes 1.0.0 (69)
item.description:
• Meetings started from your calendar always record call audio and your microphone
  • Clicking meetings in the list selects them again
  • Search sits at the top right in every section and also searches People
  • Faster meeting list

item.title: Minutes 1.0.0 (66)
item.description:
• Meeting page with a waveform player, clickable summary timecodes and a Moments column beside the transcript
  • Mark moments while recording with the bookmark button or Command-B
  • iCloud sync between your Mac and iPhone (Settings, Sync)
  • Save meetings to your own Parachute vault with a real sign-in
  • Choose which Google calendars appear, by name
  • Automatic updates
